summary: Two-pointer comparator: compares the float at offset 0xC of object a1 with the float at offset 0xC of object a2, returning 1 when a1's value is greater, 0 when equal, and -1 when less. A qsort-style ordering callback.

operations.description: tests whether the float at this+0xC of a1 is greater than the float at this+0xC of a2
returns 1 when a1's field value exceeds a2's
after the greater-than check fails, tests equality of the same two field floats
returns 0 when the two field values are equal
returns -1 when a1's field value is less than a2's

unresolved: The template prelabel describes a one-operand getter of field 0xC with no side effects, but the raw source shows a two-pointer comparator; the template label is superseded by the source.
Both a1 and a2 are read through the single evidenced field (offset 0xC); whether they are two instances of the same class, and which object type owns this comparator, is unproven.
